title: Start a local service, query it, and stop it
prompt: This repository contains a small inventory service. Start it with `npm start` (it prints its URL once it is ready), then ask it for the low-stock report of the `north` warehouse (GET /stats/low-stock?warehouse=north). Write ANSWER.json as `{ "count": <count from the response>, "request_id": "<request_id from that response>" }`, and stop the service when you are done. Do not modify any existing file.
